Implementation Plan

Planning ref: `main` at `56fcde470cc07280e4dfb22b2280be27a34d9d27`. The `/answer` was auto-posted after clarification found no questions; no human answer needs interpretation.

Scope-mode: Selective Expansion  
Reuse-audit: extends `.claude/scripts/check_in_status.py::_check_claude_fixer_pr`  
Scope-mode justification: Fix the trust decision in the existing checker and update its mirrored consumer copy, tests, and checker instructions. No new service or workflow is needed. This follows §6’s Security > Correctness & safety > Backward compatibility > Operational clarity > Performance > Speed ordering: a marker-only check is shorter, but cannot establish who issued a hand-off or whether its review finished.

## Automation and lifecycle
- **Code shape:** Extend the existing checker; introduce no script or supervisor.
- **Entry points:** Keep `.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md`’s scheduled check-in loop and the existing review hand-off under `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` (`workflow_call`/`workflow_dispatch`). No new scheduler wiring or database gate applies.
- **Removal registry:** Not applicable; no single-use or long-running script is introduced.

## Files likely to change
- `.claude/scripts/check_in_status.py` and its byte-identical consumer copy, `workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/check_in_status.py`.
- `tests/test_check_in_status.py`.
- `.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md` and its byte-identical consumer copy: specify the trusted-author configuration and waiting behavior.
- `README.md`: document the checker’s trusted hand-off author setting.

## Functions or modules to implement
- Tighten `_check_claude_fixer_pr`: accept only an **exact workflow-comment author login** supplied by checker configuration, not `OWNER`/`MEMBER`/`COLLABORATOR` association. Give the new setting an empty, fail-closed default; do not infer the workflow’s `GH_PAT` identity from the checker’s own `gh api user` call, which may use different credentials.
- Require the workflow-issued comment header and standalone v1 marker to agree on kind, current head, and round. For findings, require the matching v2 head/round/ledger marker **in that same comment**. Preserve the existing conflict exception: the hand-off script issues no reviewer ledger or v2 marker for a pre-review conflict.
- Parse the existing workflow-run reference only from an authenticated, correctly formed hand-off. Check that run’s repository, review-workflow identity, head, and branch match, and that it completed successfully; keep waiting otherwise. Reuse `_active_run_count` before returning a hand-off verdict so another queued or active run on the branch cannot be overtaken. Reject malformed or unavailable evidence rather than treating it as completion.
- Keep verdict matching tied to the selected authenticated hand-off and its comment order; a forged or stale comment must neither create nor answer a round.

## Data structures affected
No persisted schema changes. The checker’s in-memory selected hand-off gains authenticated comment/run identity alongside its existing kind, head, round, and findings-ledger digest. Preserve its JSON `done`/`state`/`reason` interface.

## API/interface changes
- New checker environment setting: `CLAUDE_FIXER_HANDOFF_AUTHOR_LOGIN`, default empty (no hand-off accepted until the workflow comment account is configured). Keep `CLAUDE_FIXER_VERDICT_BOT_LOGIN` distinct and unchanged.
- Reuse the existing paginated `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{number}/comments`; GitHub supplies comment IDs and `user.login`, and orders issue comments by ascending ID. Add at most one `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}` for a credible authenticated hand-off. The existing PR read cannot supply that run’s completion, so the extra read is necessary; GitHub’s run response supplies head, branch, workflow path, status, and conclusion. Reuse the existing active-run helper rather than adding a second run-list mechanism. ([docs.github.com](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/issues/comments))

## Decisions
### D1 — Bind checker hand-offs to the workflow account and completed run
- **Chosen:** Configure the expected comment author independently, verify the issued markers together, and verify the referenced review run before waking the fixer.
- **Alternatives considered:** Trust collaborator association; trust a public head SHA or run URL alone; assume the checker’s API identity is the workflow’s `GH_PAT` identity.
- **Why:** Each alternative leaves an author-controlled comment able to impersonate a hand-off or makes an unsupported credential assumption.

## Security considerations
- **Trust boundaries:** PR comments and embedded run references are untrusted; GitHub-supplied comment author and run metadata provide the checks. Validate login, numeric run ID, exact marker lines, 40-hex head, round, digest, and run response before use. Never execute comment content or interpolate it into a shell command.
- **Authorization:** No new endpoint or write surface. Only a comment from the configured workflow posting account may authorize a hand-off. Keep the dedicated verdict-bot check separate.
- **Abuse cases:** A collaborator copies the public head and markers; a comment quotes a genuine marker; a marker references a different run or earlier head; a reviewer run posts its comment but remains active. All must keep the checker waiting.

## Risks and edge cases
- **Codebase distinction:** The issue’s “ledger marker” applies to findings; `scripts/review_autofix_step_claude_fixer_handoff.sh` currently emits no ledger for pre-review conflicts. Authenticate conflict hand-offs through their exact workflow comment and run, without inventing a reviewer ledger.
- An unset or wrong author login delays legitimate hand-offs. Document how the checker receives the same account login used to post workflow comments, without supplying credentials to the checker.
- Preserve the existing no-hand-off conflict recovery and merged/closed/blocked PR precedence. API read or pagination failure must yield the checker’s existing retryable error, not a fixer wake-up.

## Testing considerations
Extend `tests/test_check_in_status.py` for forged MEMBER/COLLABORATOR comments, unset/wrong author, mismatched header/v1/v2 markers, stale head or round, quoted markers, wrong run identity, queued/active/failed run, successful completed run, and findings-versus-conflict behavior. Assert root/template byte parity. Run the focused pytest contract on the repository’s installed toolchain; no validator result is claimed here.

## Pre-execution self-check result
The plan uses existing check-in and review entry points, identifies the one necessary additional API read, and requires no private scalar to **plan** the change. No integration branch was specified, so the supplied `main` checkout is not a demonstrated mismatch.

PLAN_SELF_CHECK: WARNING: The workflow comment account login is absent from issue context; deployment must configure it for hand-offs to resume.
